name: Hangzhou Weiguang Electronic Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Weiguang Electronic Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of motors, fans, micro motors, drives and controllers, robots and automation equipment, pumps, and new energy vehicle parts in China. The company offers axial fan, centrifugal fan, motors, YGF-Series cross fans, compact axial fan motor, and servo motors and drive technology. Its motors are used in refrigeration, air conditioning, ventilation, etc; energy storage, heat pumps, data centers and other fields; servo motors are mainly used in industrial automation, robots, textile machinery, CNC machine tools, and other fields.
